# BlackLang

BlackLang is an AI-native deterministic intent language.

It helps AI agents turn compact `.black` source files into validated, working software.

Read these pages first:

- /reference/syntax
- /reference/entity
- /reference/page
- /cli/parse
- /cli/validate
- /cli/docs
- /ai-agents/codex
- /ai-agents/learning-cost
- /reference/blackir

Core local files in this repository:

- SPEC.md
- BLACKLANG.md
- AGENTS.md
- ROADMAP.md
- examples/warehouse/app.black
- examples/crm/app.black
- blacklang.toml

Important principle:

BlackLang may be unknown to AI models at first. Use local docs, version-aware CLI output, and JSON diagnostics as the source of truth.

Use BlackIR when a compact AI-readable project summary is better than verbose JSON.

Use `black docs <keyword> --ir` to retrieve compact local documentation for one language keyword.
